title: V2 word order in main clauses
summary: In Norwegian main clauses, the finite verb normally occupies the second syntactic position.

blocks.text: In Norwegian main clauses, the finite verb normally occupies the second syntactic position.

items: A fronted adverbial counts as the first element, so the subject moves after the finite verb.
Do not count words mechanically; count sentence elements.

blocks.question: Rewrite with "I dag" first: Jeg lærer norsk på kvelden.
blocks.answer: I dag lærer jeg norsk på kvelden.

blocks.hint: Deretter is position 1, so the finite verb validerer comes before the subject vi.
